kcie01.title: Virgo, voice note, take four
kcie01.caption: Four takes, one handwritten script, one neighbour's dog, and the final answer was a text. Fourteen minutes well spent. Who else rehearses a voice note like it's a speech?

kcie02.title: Gemini typed LMAO with a straight face
kcie02.caption: Laughed out loud on the bus for the crush's cat story. Typed LMAOOOO for the friend's fog joke with a perfectly blank face. Which friend gets your real laugh?

kcie03.title: Leo checked their reflection mid-date
kcie03.caption: The window, the spoon, the phone screen: three reflection checks before the story about the dog even ended. Then the date pulled out a pocket mirror. Match made?

kcie04.title: Cancer saved a 'gn' screenshot
kcie04.caption: One 'gn :)' got zoomed to 400%, archived, printed and framed on the wall. The folder is at 48 now. What's the most screenshotted text on your phone?

kcie05.title: Aries replied in 0.3 seconds
kcie05.caption: The phone buzzed and Aries cleared the couch in one dive. The play-it-cool timer lasted nine seconds. Then they replied just as fast. Fast texter or slow texter?

kcie06.title: Taurus said 'on my way' from bed
kcie06.caption: 'On my way!!' sent from under a blanket. Leaving in 5, then 10, then 15. Then the friend sent a photo from their own bed. Who in your group texts it first?

kcie07.title: The Libra committee answers 'hey'
kcie07.caption: Four drafts, one whiteboard, a vote, a recount and a tearful Pisces tie-break. Two hours later, the 'hey' was meant for someone else. Who's on your reply committee?

kcie08.title: Sagittarius planned the trip after one chat
kcie08.caption: Ten minutes of talking at a party and there was already a map, an itinerary and matching luggage. Day one: learn their name. Who plans the whole trip after one good chat?
